shakee_blocki.config.title: Shakee Blocki Configuration
shakee_blocki.config.placement.enable.to: Enables or disables the placement animation.
shakee_blocki.config.placement.mode.tool: EXPAND: Grows from a point in center. SQUASH_AND_STRETCH: Jelly bounce. FALL: Drops from above. SPIN: 360 spin & pop. MATERIAL_BASED: Auto-adapts to block material.
How many ticks the placement animation lasts (20 ticks = 1 second).
shakee_blocki.config.placement.expand_in: Starting size of the block in Expand mode (0.0 = point in center).
shakee_blocki.config.placement.expand_ov: Adds a subtle cartoon pop where the block briefly expands slightly larger than 1.0 before settling.
shakee_blocki.config.placement.easing.to: Easing curve applied to the placement spring decay.
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.enable.too: Enables or disables the block squash/shrink animation while mining.
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.mode.toolt: SHRINK: Shrinks to center. SQUASH_AND_STRETCH: Cartoon jelly squash & explosive pop.
Minimum size reached before fully broken (0.5 = 50% shrink).
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.start_dela: Ticks before the breaking animation begins after you start mining (0 = instant).
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.loop_ticks: Duration of one full breaking animation loop.
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.keep_alive: How long mining progress stays alive between client updates before the block smoothly returns.
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.return_tic: How fast the block smoothly returns to rest when mining stops.
shakee_blocki.config.breaking.animate_co: Synchronously animates double chests, beds, and doors as single multi-blocks.
shakee_blocki.config.physics.neighbor_ri: Adjacent blocks receive a subtle physical shockwave bounce when placing blocks.
Strength and bounce height of neighbor shockwaves.
shakee_blocki.config.physics.velocity_bi: Blocks lean and tilt dynamically towards your movement direction when placing on the run.
Multiplier for player velocity momentum tilt.
shakee_blocki.config.filters.technical.t: Disables animations for redstone wire, torches, buttons, levers, repeaters, and rails.
shakee_blocki.config.filters.foliage.too: Disables animations for flowers, saplings, tall grass, and mushrooms.
shakee_blocki.config.filters.blacklist.t: Comma-separated block IDs to exclude from animations (e.g. oak_sapling, dandelion, stone).
